alignments.note: Construct chain rendered attributively (rule 28): the rectum מָוֶת supplies *Dead*.
Construct noun keeps only its own word.
Hiphil 'make stink' recast as *cause ... an evil odor*; discontinuous under rule 25. Head on *odor* as the noun realizing the lexeme; *evil* is a defensible alternative head under rule 31.
No article morpheme; the supplied *the* stands before the construct's own word (rule 29).
Rectum takes the relational *of* (rule 19); the second supplied *the* stands before its own word.
יַבִּיעַ rendered *to send forth*; head on the lexical verb, *forth* a phrasal particle (rule 44).
Italic *so*: a correlative connective the ASV supplies for a clause with no conjunction morpheme in it (rule 14).
The comparative predicate יָקָר is recast as the verb *outweigh*, with its auxiliary *doth*; unit discontinuous under rule 25.
The supplied indefinite article determines the nominal expression and joins its noun (rule 15).
Adjective keeps only its own word.
Comparative מִן left unrendered by the *outweigh* recasting, exactly as גָּדַל ... מִן → *exceeded* leaves its preposition (rule 35).
No waw stands between the two comparative phrases; the coordinating *and* answers to no morpheme (rules 14, 42).

review_notes: The ASV margin (*to stink and putrefy*, *him that is valued for wisdom*) was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).
